hooks.name: Buddy: Session Start
hooks.description: セッション開始時にBLEブリッジへ通知し、M5Stackのペットを起こす

action.command: echo '[HOOK] SessionStart fired at '$(date '+%H:%M:%S') >> /tmp/kiro-buddy-hooks.log && curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:9876/event -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"event":"session_start"}' 2>/dev/null || true
